blocks.html:
Do you want to help reduce traffic, local pollution and the effects of global warming?
Leave the car at home and take public transport!

USI Arcobaleno travel pass

The Arcobaleno is a zone-based travel pass that allows free travel on all public transports in the regions covered by the purchased zones.
Thanks to USI's contribution, its employees can obtain a 2nd class annual Arcobaleno travel pass with a 50% discount. The discount applies exclusively on the home-work-home route.

By giving up the use of a car, you save on vehicle maintenance and parking costs, as well as reducing your environmental impact, with a significant reduction in energy consumption and harmful emissions.

New: from 1 May 2025, USI employees living in Italy will have the possibility to apply for the Arcobaleno cross-border pass for the Italian section via the Arcobaleno company form. How does this work? When completing the order form for the Arcobaleno travel pass, simply specify the entire desired route, e.g. from Como Camerlata to Lugano. However the 50% overall discount only applies to the cost of the annual Arcobaleno travel pass on the Swiss segment. For example, for a Como - Lugano annual travel pass, the route benefiting from the discount will be from Chiasso to Lugano.

items.title: Arcobaleno pass - Eligibility
items.html:
To benefit from the Arcobaleno offer, you must be a USI employee (administrative or academic) with an active employment contract for at least 6 months from the date of issue of the subscription. Apprentices employed by USI are requested to contact directly the HR Service for the subscription issue.

Should the collaboration with USI end before the subscription expires, a refund of the fee paid by USI as employer for the remaining months of the subscription's validity will be requested

items.title: Arcobaleno pass - Costs
items.html:
The Arcobaleno travel pass prices can be calculated using the cantonal Calculator (Italian only). From the price displayed in the calculator, you will have to subtract 50% of the figure to obtain the final cost of your subscription. Subsequently, the HR Service will contact the employees to pay their fee, with the possibility of paying in instalments (up to 4).

The 50% reduction on the cost of the travel pass only applies to the home-work-home route in 2nd class. If additional zones or 1st class are desired, only the basic reduction of 15% offered by Comunità tariffale Arcobaleno applies on these additional routes and/or for class changes.

items.title: Arcobaleno pass - Instructions for application
items.html:
To start the application procedure for a new Arcobaleno travel pass, please fill in the following form, bearing in mind a few details:

  • In the field ‘Work location’, enter USI Lugano or USI Mendrisio
  • In the field ‘E-mail address of the responsible department’, enter personale.lu@usi.ch

The HR Service will examine the request and forward it to SBB for processing and issuing. This can take up to approximately 10 working days; therefore, we recommend that you start the procedure promptly.

The new travel pass will be delivered to your home if it is a first issue, or it will be displayed with updated dates and zones in your SBB app. There will be no further communication from SBB, so please consult the app.

items.title: Arcobaleno pass - Renewal
items.html: The Arcobaleno travel pass subscriptions are not subject to automatic renewal when they expire. Please apply for a new request using the procedure described above in the ‘Instructions for application’ section.

items.title: Arcobaleno pass - Further Information
items.html:
For further information or if you have any questions, please refer to the links in the Quicklinks section here on the right or contact one of the following email addresses:

  • sosta@usi.ch
